answer: Cap trust growth with a single network-wide budget that thaws at a glacier's pace: each epoch the ledger releases only a fixed quantum of standing, split proportionally among all newcomers sharing a funding root. One honest joiner claims a real ledge of footing; an operator blooming a lotus of clones from one treasury forces those clones to divide that same fixed budget among themselves, so a thousand fakes collectively rise no faster than one identity. Standing is rivalrous and globally scarce, so flooding only dilutes your own swarm.
